scenarios.name: follow-up
scenarios.result:
1. Mountains rise where the earth folds and lifts.
2. Snow lingers on their peaks long after spring arrives.
3. Their slopes shelter forests, rivers, and quiet valleys.
4. Climbers test themselves against thin air and steep rock.
5. From a summit, the world looks both smaller and clearer.
